title: He maimai aroha
content:
17 August 2006

He maimai aroha

  • Mita Ririnui
State

Labour MP Mita Ririnui has expressed deep sorrow at the passing of Te Arikinui Te Atairangikaahu this morning.

Her contribution over the past four decades has been unmatched by any contemporary or traditional Maori leader and she leaves an impressive record of achievement.

Te Arikinui spearheaded Maori development in a number of key areas with a strong focus on education.

"All of our Maori caucus members will mourn her loss. Our immediate thoughts are with Nanaia and we will join her at Turangawaewae as the nation delivers its final farewell over the coming days.

"Her humble gait hid a strong spirit, sharp mind and a pragmatism to get things done.

"I met Te Arikinui on numerous occasions, her smile was infectious and always welcoming, she epitomised Kingitanga which was founded on unity and a common purpose to serve the people.

"Te Arikinui can pass knowing that she lived a full life and lead her people through a period of change that will continue to reverberate for many years to come.

No reira kei te tangi te ngakau
Therefore my heart weeps
Kua ngaro atu koe
You are lost
E kaikini nei ahau, tatou katoa hoki, i te hinapouri
We are gnawed with a profound sadness
Pakoko kau toku kanohi i te pouri
Our faces are etched with grief
Haere atu ra ki a ratou ma kua wheturangitia
Go to those who have taken their place among the stars
Ki te huinga o te kahurangi
To the great gathering place of rainbows
Aue te mamae
Alas the grief
Kei te tangi nga maunga huri noa, kei te waipuke nga awa, kei te maringi mai nga kapua pouri
All of the mountains weep, the rivers are flooding and the clouds of sadness gather
I rere mai koe i runga i nga pakau o te hau, rere atu ki a Taupiri he moenga rangatira whakaoti atu
You flew to us on the winds and now you must fly to your ancestral mountain to rest among the chiefs for a final time
No reira Te Ata, moe mai, moe mai, moe mai
Therefore Te Ata may you sleep and rest
Mo ake tonu atu paimarire
For ever more in peace
